# shadcn-svelte attribution

The Badge component and its Nova styles are copied from [shadcn-svelte at 688cff9494c8f38fb80dd28dd8c11b590af251a6](https://github.com/huntabyte/shadcn-svelte/tree/688cff9494c8f38fb80dd28dd8c11b590af251a6). Imports use SvelteKit 3 subpath aliases. Only the required `WithElementRef` type is retained from the upstream helpers; `cn` follows the manual installation pattern.
